# Jump to the Pane Needing You (goto_attention, ⌘J), in any tab: waiting
# for you first, then failed, then finished, then round again. A failed or
# finished one is seen once you're there: the next press goes on from it.
type:printf '\033]2;FINISHER\a\033]7501;state=done:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;ASKER\a\033]7501;state=blocked:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;BREAKER\a\033]7501;state=error:app=probe\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;IDLER\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-selected:IDLER
key:cmd+j
expect-selected:ASKER
key:cmd+j
expect-selected:BREAKER
key:cmd+j
expect-selected:FINISHER
key:cmd+j
expect-selected:ASKER
# Only the asker still needs you: the action (the palette's, a script's) stays.
action:goto_attention
expect-selected:ASKER
